skills.description_zh: 一句话简介： 基于 social-auto-upload 的小红书内容上传工具，支持「按需上传」——你给任意文件或目录路径，它先扫描预览，再交互确认标题 / 标签 / 发布声明 / 定时，最后自动上传。视频走 upload-video，多张图片自动合并成一个图文笔记。  详细介绍：  按需上传（默认主流程）：不再依赖固定监控目录。给单个文件或整个文件夹（视频 / 图片混合也行），脚本先列出发现了几个视频、几张图，再跟你确认标题、标签、发布声明（正文）、是否定时，你拍板后才真正上传。 三种发布策略：draft（存草稿，默认）/ immediate（立即发）/ scheduled（定时发，格式 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM）。 多平台支持：小红书最完整；同项目内置抖音、快手、B站、腾讯视频号、YouTube 的上传器（CLI 已注册命令）。 图片图文：多张图片自动合并成一个小红书图文笔记；视频各自独立上传。 技术原理：使用 patchright（Playwright 分支）驱动真实浏览器，模拟人工操作创作者后台，靠 cookie 登录态上传，不走官方 API，无需申请开发者权限。 使用前提：  本机装有 uv（Python 包管理器）。 首次运行 uv sync 自动安装依赖（patchright / opencv 等，需联网，可能几分钟）。 首次需扫码登录：uv run sau xiaohongshu login --account default --headed，生成 cookies。 浏览器驱动：默认复用本机 Chromium；跨机可设 XHS_CHROME_PATH 或让 patchright 自动下载。 典型用法： uv run python xhs_upload_on_demand.py --path "/path/to/媒体" --title "标题" --tags "标签1,标签2" --desc "发布声明" --strategy draft 单个视频 / 单张图也能传：uv run python xhs_upload_on_demand.py --path "/Users/xxx/视频.mp4" 在 WorkBuddy 对话里直接说「上传这个 /path/文件」也会自动走这套流程。  注意事项：  依赖 cookie 登录态，过期需重新扫码登录。 平台前端改版可能导致上传器失效，需跟进修复选择器。 draft 草稿是浏览器本地存储，脚本无法后续管理（删除 / 改定时需用 scheduled 策略）。 有频率风控，脚本内置每传一个间隔 3 秒。 标签 / 分类建议： 小红书, 内容运营, 自动化上传, 自媒体, 效率工具, social-auto-upload

# Teams Automation Skill

Unified Microsoft Graph API client for Microsoft 365.
Supports the full office automation lifecycle: Mail, Calendar, Teams Chat/Channel
(read & send), Users, Presence, Files, SharePoint Sites, and Tasks.

## When to Use

Trigger this skill when the user:
- Wants to read/search/send emails via Graph API
- Needs to query calendar events
- Asks about Teams messages (chats or channel) — read or send
- Wants to search/lookup users in the organization
- Checks someone's online/availability status
- Needs to access SharePoint sites or OneDrive files
- Wants to read Planner/To Do tasks
- Mentions "Graph API", "Teams", "teams-automation", "邮件", "日历", "Teams消息", "发送消息", etc.

## Quick Start

### Prerequisites

1. Register an Azure AD application:
   - Go to **Azure Portal** → **App registrations** → **New registration**
   - Set redirect URI to `https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/nativeclient`
   - Under **API Permissions**, add the required Microsoft Graph delegated permissions (see [Permissions](#permissions))
   - Under **Authentication**, enable "Allow public client flows" (for device-code flow)
   - 复制 `config.example.yaml` 为 `config.yaml`，填入你的 `client_id` 和 `tenant`

### Authentication Flow

The skill handles OAuth2 device-code authentication automatically:

```
1. Script checks cached token in .msal_token.json
2. If expired, tries refresh_token
3. If refresh fails, initiates device-code flow:
   → Prints verification URL + user code
   → User visits https://login.microsoft.com/device and enters code
   → User signs in with corporate account
   → Token cached for future use
```

The token is shared across all modules — authenticate once, use everywhere.

### Basic Usage

```bash
# Send an email
python scripts/graph_client.py --send-email --to "user@example.com" --subject "Test" --body "Hello"

# Read emails
python scripts/graph_client.py --email-list 15

# Read calendar events
python scripts/graph_client.py --calendar --days 7

# List Teams chats
python scripts/graph_client.py --chats

# Read chat messages with a person
python scripts/graph_client.py --chat-messages --person "UserName"

# Send a message to a person by name (auto finds user, finds/creates chat, sends)
python scripts/graph_client.py --send-to-person "TargetUser" --message "Hi, this is a test"

# Send a message to yourself
python scripts/graph_client.py --send-to-self "Reminder for later"

# Send a message to an existing chat by ID
python scripts/graph_client.py --send-chat-message "Hello" --chat-id "19:xxx@thread.v2"

# Search users
python scripts/graph_client.py --user-search "UserName"

# Check user presence (by email/UPN)
python scripts/graph_client.py --presence "user@example.com"

# Quick presence check by name (search + status)
python scripts/graph_client.py --status "UserName"

# Get my profile
python scripts/graph_client.py --me

# List SharePoint sites
python scripts/graph_client.py --sites

# List document libraries in a SharePoint site
python scripts/graph_client.py --site-drives "SiteName"

# List folder contents (OneDrive root by default)
python scripts/graph_client.py --ls
# List specific folder
python scripts/graph_client.py --ls --folder "MyFolder"
# List SharePoint folder
python scripts/graph_client.py --ls --drive "DRIVE_ID" --folder "SubFolder"

# Download a file
python scripts/graph_client.py --download "ITEM_ID" --save "./file.xlsx"
```

### From Python Code

```python
from graph_client import GraphClient

client = GraphClient()
client.ensure_token()  # Auto auth

# Email
emails = client.list_emails(count=15)
unread = client.list_emails(count=10, filter_unread=True)
client.send_email("Subject", "Body text", "user@example.com")

# Calendar
events = client.list_events(days_back=7)

# Teams
chats = client.list_chats()
msgs = client.get_chat_messages(person_name="UserName")
channels = client.list_channels(team_name="TeamName")

# Teams — Send messages
result = client.send_message_to_person("TargetUser", "Hello!")
client.send_chat_message(chat_id="19:xxx@thread.v2", content="Hi")
client.ensure_self_chat()         # get or create self-chat
client.find_or_create_chat(user_id="xxx")  # find/create 1:1 chat

# Users
user = client.get_me()
results = client.search_users("UserName")
presence = client.get_presence("user@example.com")
status_results = client.quick_presence("UserName")
manager = client.get_manager()

# Files & Sites
files = client.list_recent_files()
sites = client.list_sites()
site = client.get_site("SiteName")                        # find site by name
drives = client.list_site_drives("SiteName")              # list doc libraries
items = client.list_folder_items("me", "MyFolder")        # OneDrive folder
items = client.list_folder_items(drive_id, "SubFolder")   # SharePoint folder
path = client.download_file("me", item_id, "./file.txt")  # download

# Tasks
tasks = client.list_tasks()
```

## Permissions

| Scope | API |
|:------|:----|
| `Mail.Read` | `GET /me/messages` |
| `Mail.Send` | `POST /me/sendMail` |
| `Calendars.Read` | `GET /me/events` |
| `Chat.Read` | `GET /me/chats`, `GET /chats/{id}/messages` |
| `Chat.ReadWrite` | `POST /chats`, `POST /chats/{id}/messages` |
| `Team.ReadBasic.All` | `GET /teams` |
| `Channel.ReadBasic.All` | `GET /teams/{id}/channels` |
| `ChannelMessage.Read.All` | `GET /teams/{id}/channels/{id}/messages` |
| `User.Read` | `GET /me` |
| `User.Read.All` | `GET /users` |
| `Presence.Read.All` | `POST /communications/getPresencesByUserId` |
| `Files.Read.All` | `GET /me/drive`, `GET /drives/{id}` |
| `Sites.Read.All` | `GET /sites` |
| `Tasks.Read` | `GET /me/planner/tasks` |

## Files

```
teams-automation/
├── .gitignore              # Prevents config.yaml from leaking
├── SKILL.md                # Skill documentation
├── config.example.yaml     # Configuration template
├── config.yaml             # Your local config (gitignored)
└── scripts/
    └── graph_client.py     # Unified Graph API client
```

## Configuration

`config.yaml` structure:

| Field | Required | Description |
|:------|:---------|:------------|
| `client_id` | **Yes** | Azure AD application (client) ID |
| `tenant` | **Yes** | Azure AD tenant domain (e.g. `yourcompany.com`) |
| `scopes` | No | Custom permission scopes (defaults to read + write scopes) |

## Token Cache

Token is stored in workspace root at `.msal_token.json`:
```json
{
  "access_token": "eyJ...",
  "refresh_token": "0.A..."
}
```

skills.description_zh: 公众号写作全家桶（wechat-suite） ·一句话简介 把写公众号文章要用的 7 个 skill（选题、初稿、文风、标题、全流程构建 + 微信排版/封面）打包成一个安装器，上传一次、下载一次，全部装好。 这套 skill 是什么 wechat-suite 是面向公众号作者的 AI 写作工具集合，覆盖从选题策划到排版封面的完整链路。它本体是一个安装器 skill：下载安装后跑一下脚本，内置的 7 个 skill 会自动铺到你的 skills 目录，无需逐个查找下载。 包含的 7 个 skill wechat 系列（写作流程） wechat-topic-outline-planner — 公众号选题与大纲策划：粗点子转成高价值角度 + 主/备大纲。 wechat-draft-writer — 公众号初稿写作：基于参考素材和文风 DNA 生成高保真初稿。 wechat-style-profiler — 文风 DNA 梳理：从参考文章建立可复用风格画像（14 维）。 wechat-title-generator — 公众号标题生成与评估：生成候选标题并筛掉低质、推荐最优。 wechat-article-builder — 公众号全流程自动生成与发布：选题→大纲→正文→封面→排版→草稿推送一条龙。 xiaohu 系列（排版与封面） xiaohu-wechat-format — 微信排版：Markdown 结构化预处理（标题/加粗/callout/分隔符）。 xiaohu-wechat-cover — 公众号封面图生成器：一步出 4 张不同风格封面。 适用人群 公众号运营 / 自媒体作者，想用 AI 接管从选题到发布的固定动作 需要统一文风与排版规范的内容团队 安装后怎么用 装好 wechat-suite 后，在对话里直接说人话即可触发，例如： "基于这篇参考文章写篇公众号文章并推送" → wechat-article-builder "帮我做选题和大纲" → wechat-topic-outline-planner "给我生成几个标题" → wechat-title-generator "把这篇文章排版一下" → xiaohu-wechat-format "生成 4 张封面" → xiaohu-wechat-cover 单 skill 简介（可贴到各自上架页） wechat-topic-outline-planner — 公众号选题与大纲策划。 wechat-draft-writer — 公众号初稿写作（基于素材 + 文风 DNA）。 wechat-style-profiler — 文风 DNA 梳理与画像建立。 wechat-title-generator — 公众号标题生成与评估。 wechat-article-builder — 公众号文章全流程自动生成与发布。 xiaohu-wechat-format — 微信排版结构化预处理。 xiaohu-wechat-cover — 公众号封面图生成器（4 风格）。
